tests.title: Course search and sale/discontinued views filter the catalog
tests.goal: The course catalog search and status views return matching courses.
preconditions: At least one active course and one course in the selected status view are available.

steps.text: Sign in to the staging CRM and open Courses & Enrolment > Courses Information.
Search by the name of an existing course.
Review All, On Sales Courses, and Discontinued Course views.

expected.text: Search results include the selected course and its displayed price, category, and status.
On Sales Courses and Discontinued Course views contain only courses in the selected view.
